touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Burgh le Marsh qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL and DOBSON'S WINDMILL. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Burgh le Marsh: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Burgh le Marsh offers CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL, DOBSON'S WINDMILL, HANSON'S WINDMILL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL and DOBSON'S WINDMILL, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL
